limitations: One timed screen per variant; no statistical confidence interval.
Outputs may change when admission or floating-point reductions change.
No candidate is promoted solely on a kernel microbenchmark.
Fresh twenty held-out contracts remain unscored during tuning.
RAM speed was not measured. Earlier bandwidth/activity evidence remains separate.

fp8_microbenchmarks.protocol: One CUDA graph timing per tuple: 1,000 warmup launches and 1,000 timed launches. Smaller matrices include both a single-copy mode and a rotating operand set of about 128 MiB; the vocabulary matrix has one copy. GPU event time excludes host scheduling. These are kernel measurements, not model qualification.

source.change: Benchmark reader honors sealed RAM FDs; arithmetic unchanged.

fp8_microbenchmarks.limitation: Individual FP8 gains did not predict the global accumulator experiment, which lost model throughput.

prefill_microbenchmarks.protocol: Synthetic expert dimensions, six balanced rotated samples per variant. Each sample uses 64 CUDA graph launches with three rotating compressed operand copies. Tile zero reconstructs the complete FP16 matrix and calls cuBLAS; the other variants reconstruct tiles inside WMMA kernels. GPU event time excludes host scheduling.

safety.scope: Complete synthetic prefill test execution; not a whole-model bank memory check.

results.scope: Boundary tiles, short K slices, normal/outlier activations and missing-scratch rejection
Expert matrix dimensions at16/128/512 token rows, each with normal and outlier activations
Boundary tiles, short K slices, normal/outlier activations and missing-scratch rejection

prefill_microbenchmarks.finding: Every new 128-row split-K variant was slower than reconstruction plus cuBLAS. The existing 32-row kernel improved down projections at16/32/64 rows; this is a kernel result only. The new split-K kernel is not called by the model executor.

activation.scope: Instrumented safety check with real promotions; timings excluded.

bank_safety.finding: Four increasingly focused bank diagnostics were intentionally interrupted because of instrumentation cost and the rejected throughput tradeoff. No clean bank memory-check claim.
